recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not add SearchParameter resources for _sort, _count, _include, _revinclude, _summary, _total, _elements, _contained, _containedType, _format, or _pretty under this issue; changing that policy needs a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-26430 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction asking that missing SearchParameter definitions from search.html be fixed in the registry and NPM packages.
initial_application: No source-changing commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-26430 was found. Nearby implementation commits added or restored the Resource/DomainResource definitions, and current active source defines _text, _content, _list, _has, _type, _filter, _query, and the other Resource-wide parameters that should be SearchParameter resources.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread and 2022-04-18 FHIR-I minutes distinguish true missing SearchParameters from search-result controls. FHIR-36879 later clarified in source/search.html that result controls are not SearchParameter resources, and current CapabilityStatement comments explain how to document non-true parameters without a definition URL.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because current source and package output already match the final issue family decisions.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction asking to fix missing SearchParameter definitions for parameters documented on search.html.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed request and the all-resource plus search-result parameters that must be checked.

evidence_items.summary: Current active source defines the true all-resource SearchParameter resources including _content, _list, _has, _type, _filter, _query, and DomainResource _text.
evidence_items.learned: The current build inputs contain the formal definitions that FHIR-26430 required for true SearchParameter resources.

evidence_items.summary: Current narrative says search-result parameters are not SearchParameter resources, and CapabilityStatement guidance says non-true parameters omit .definition and use type special.
evidence_items.learned: The absence of registry resources for search-result and HTTP controls is an intentional rule, not a missed FHIR-26430 application.

evidence_items.summary: The thread records the original report, the 2022 fix, confirmation that true missing parameters appeared, and the explanation that result controls would not be formal R4B definitions.
evidence_items.learned: Community evidence separates the completed missing-definition fix from the intentionally omitted search-result controls.

evidence_items.summary: Minutes say _sort and _element are not defined because they do not have type/path and that CapabilityStatement can indicate support without a definition URL.
evidence_items.learned: The work group explicitly accepted omitting result-control definition URLs.

evidence_items.summary: Source history added or restored the Resource-level definitions now present for the true missing parameters.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-26430 appears to have been applied through nearby untagged and later related source commits rather than a FHIR-26430-tagged commit.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-36879 clarified that controls such as _format and _pretty are not registry SearchParameters; FHIR-39335 later restored R5 _has/_filter/_in definitions.
evidence_items.learned: Later final decisions refine the boundary of FHIR-26430 and are already reflected in current source.
